test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has introduced a dedicated Semiconductor Policy 2022 - 27 with a view to generate at least 2,00,000 new employment opportunities in the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujarat** has introduced a dedicated Semiconductor Policy 2022 - 27.
 
• The policy aims to generate at least **2,00,000 new employment opportunities** in the state.
 
• Gujarat's semiconductor policy is designed to attract investments in the semiconductor sector and make the state a hub for electronics manufacturing.
 
• The initiative reflects the state's commitment to advancing technology and creating a robust ecosystem for semiconductor manufacturing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Semiconductors are crucial components in modern electronics, including computers, smartphones, and various other devices.
 
• The global semiconductor market is highly competitive, with countries and states vying to attract investment and establish manufacturing facilities.
 
• Gujarat's policy includes incentives and support measures for companies investing in semiconductor manufacturing, research, and development.
 
• This move is part of India's broader strategy to become self-reliant in semiconductor production and reduce dependency on imports.
